authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11378 section 2 vardhanī broom expressly lists bārni/baṛhanī and Sambalpur banneibā sweep. The r-bearing forms fit this broom family; bare banni needs distinguishing alternative broom formations. Reviewed comparator: KochariyaEastDanuwar barni “broom” (f_vt2sgeswmq4ro). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9828 manuṣya explicitly gives Bshk mīš/mĩš young man/husband with plural mānuš, and Palula mēš/mīš. These particular short-i forms are supported by the full entry; this does not resolve the separate Khowar moš ambiguity. Reviewed comparator: DewasDoneDanuwar manus “person” (f_d4u2hg5dy2iya). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
